setup: Three values are written as tenths so that they can be ordered.

steps.say: The numerators are [[a]], [[b]] and [[c]], all over the same denominator of 10.
With a shared denominator the size of a tenth is fixed, so the numerators decide the order.
A decimal written to one place is the same as that many tenths, so it takes its place on the same scale.

answer: So the value asked for is [[answer]].
